name: ZX_FC_TYPES_B
description: This table stores fiscal classification types, which are the schemes or systems of classification or categorization used by tax authorities. Each row records a fiscal classification type for a specific classification category.

columns.name: CLASSIFICATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Fiscal classification type code

columns.name: CLASSIFICATION_TYPE_CATEG_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates category of this fiscal classification type

columns.name: CLASSIFICATION_TYPE_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates group of this fiscal classification type

columns.name: DELIMITER
columns.description: Column for recording the character used to delimit classification codes of different levels in a concatanated string value for a classificaiton code of this fiscal classification type

columns.name: OWNER_TABLE_CODE
columns.description: Data source table that contains the classification codes for this fiscal classification type

columns.name: OWNER_ID_NUM
columns.description: Numeric column of the source table that uniquely identifies classification codes of this fiscal classification type

columns.name: OWNER_ID_CHAR
columns.description: Alphanumeric column of the source table that uniquely identifies classification codes of this fiscal classification type

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective from date

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective to date

columns.name: START_POSITION
columns.description: Starting position of substring of source table codes that incorporate the valid classificaiton codes for this fiscal classification type

columns.name: NUM_CHARACTERS
columns.description: Number of characters in the substring of source table codes that incorporate the valid classificaiton codes for this fiscal classification type

columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CLASSIFICATION_TYPE_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Maximum number of levels allowed to create codes for this classification type. If data source is other than ZX_FC_CODES_B,  this column stores the level from original classifications that composes valid codes for this classification type.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.
